accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro.part1: We want as many people as possible to be able to use this website. PUM is a small, private, non-commercial portfolio and project site run by a group of friends and students, not a public-sector body. We nevertheless aim to follow the principles of
accessibility.intro.part2: Level AA as far as is reasonably possible for us.
accessibility.measures.title: Measures
accessibility.measures.item1: Semantic HTML and accessible component patterns where possible.
accessibility.measures.item2: Keyboard navigation support and visible focus states.
accessibility.measures.item3: Sufficient color contrast and scalable text where it does not break the design.
accessibility.measures.item4: Labels for inputs and ARIA attributes where appropriate.
accessibility.measures.item5: Respect for system preferences such as “reduced motion”.
accessibility.measures.item6: Ongoing, best-effort fixes when we notice or are told about issues.
accessibility.compatibility.title: Compatibility
accessibility.compatibility.body: Our site is designed to work with current versions of major browsers (for example, Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) on desktop and mobile. We try to support assistive technologies such as NVDA, VoiceOver and TalkBack on supported platforms, but we cannot test every combination.
accessibility.limitations.title: Known limitations
accessibility.limitations.item1.label: Interactive maps and third-party content:
accessibility.limitations.item1.text: Map and geocoding features may rely on third-party libraries and map tiles which are not fully keyboard or screen-reader accessible.
accessibility.limitations.item2.label: Visual effects and animations:
accessibility.limitations.item2.text: Some visual components (such as animated graphics, logo tickers, or typing effects) may be harder to use for some people. Where possible we take system “reduced motion” settings into account, but there may still be motion on the page.
accessibility.limitations.item3.label: User-generated content:
accessibility.limitations.item3.text: Images, PDFs or other files uploaded by users (for example, project screenshots or CVs) may not be fully accessible.
accessibility.limitations.item4.label: Languages:
accessibility.limitations.item4.text: The primary content language of this site is English. Some parts of the interface can be switched between English and German, but not all content is available in both languages yet.
accessibility.feedback.title: Feedback & contact
accessibility.feedback.intro: If you encounter accessibility barriers, please let us know – we are maintaining this project next to our studies and jobs and appreciate constructive feedback:
accessibility.feedback.disclaimer: We will do our best to respond and fix issues, but as this is a private side project, response times may vary.
accessibility.legal.title: Legal background & enforcement
accessibility.legal.body1: Many EU rules on web accessibility and formal accessibility statements are aimed at public-sector bodies and certain commercial services. PUM is a private, non-registered project and is therefore typically not in the same legal category as public administrations or large service providers. Nevertheless, we voluntarily publish this accessibility statement and work on improvements where we can.
accessibility.legal.body2: If you are not satisfied with our response to accessibility feedback, you can contact local disability advocacy organisations or general consumer advice centres in your country for further guidance.
accessibility.footer.disclaimer: This statement is provided on a best-effort basis and does not constitute legal advice.

privacy.metadata.title: Privacy Policy – PUM
privacy.metadata.description: How we handle your personal data and your rights.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We respect your privacy. This page explains what personal data we process on this website, for what purposes, and how you can exercise your rights. PUM is a small, private, non-commercial portfolio and project site run by a group of friends/students.
privacy.section.controller.title: 1. Controller
privacy.section.controller.body1: The controller responsible for processing personal data in connection with this website within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is:
privacy.section.controller.name: Mykhailo Kozyrev
privacy.section.controller.body2: The site is operated as a private, non-commercial project by a small group of friends/students (not a registered association or company).
privacy.section.data.title: 2. What data we process & why
privacy.section.data.serverLogs.label: Server log data:
privacy.section.data.serverLogs.text: When you visit our website, our hosting provider automatically processes technical data such as your IP address, date and time of access, URL accessed, referrer URL, and basic browser information. This is necessary to deliver the website and to ensure stability and security (for example, to detect misuse). Legal basis: our legitimate interests in running a secure website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.section.data.contact.label: Contact requests:
privacy.section.data.contact.text: If you contact us (for example via email or the contact form), we process the information you provide (such as name, email address, role and your message) in order to handle your request. Legal basis: depending on the context, this is either steps prior to entering into a contract or answering your enquiry (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) or our legitimate interests in responding to requests (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR); where you clearly consent, Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR.
privacy.section.data.accounts.label: Accounts, member profiles & portfolio content:
privacy.section.data.accounts.text: If the site allows you to log in or create a member profile, we process login data (for example, email and password), basic profile information and optional content you choose to share (such as profile photos, project descriptions, event participation or uploaded documents/CVs). This is used to provide the account and display your content on the site. Legal basis: performance of a contract / user relationship (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and, for public profile visibility or optional details, your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).
privacy.section.data.integrations.label: Technical integrations & maps:
privacy.section.data.integrations.text: If we embed maps or similar third-party services, the providers of those services may receive technical data (such as IP address and request details) when content is loaded. Legal basis: our legitimate interests in providing a modern, informative website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR); where required, we will ask for your consent beforehand (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).
privacy.section.data.preferences.label: Preferences (theme & language):
privacy.section.data.preferences.text: We store your chosen dark/light theme and language (English/German) in your browser (for example, using local storage) so the website remembers your preference on the same device. This does not create a personal profile and is not used for tracking. Legal basis: our legitimate interests in providing a user-friendly website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.section.cookies.title: 3. Cookies, local storage & analytics
privacy.section.cookies.intro: We try to run this website with as few cookies as possible:
privacy.section.cookies.item1: We may use necessary cookies (for example, a session cookie and CSRF protection) to keep you logged in to your account and to protect forms. These are required for the site to function securely.
privacy.section.cookies.item2: We use local storage in your browser to remember your chosen theme (dark/light) and interface language (English/German). This information stays on your device unless you clear it in your browser.
privacy.section.cookies.item3: We currently do not use third-party analytics or advertising trackers (such as Google Analytics or ad networks) on this site. If this changes in the future, we will update this policy and, where required, ask for your consent before placing such cookies.
privacy.section.cookies.footer: You can control and delete cookies and local storage entries yourself via your browser settings. However, the site or login may not work correctly without technically necessary cookies.
privacy.section.recipients.title: 4. Recipients & data transfers
privacy.section.recipients.body1: We use external service providers to host this website and, where applicable, to send emails or store files. These providers act as data processors on our behalf and are contractually obliged to handle personal data only according to our instructions and to implement appropriate security measures.
privacy.section.recipients.body2: In general we aim to use providers within the EU/EEA. If data is transferred to countries outside the EU/EEA (for example because a service provider is based there), this is done on the basis of appropriate safeguards such as EU Standard Contractual Clauses, or on the basis of your explicit consent where required by law.
privacy.section.recipients.ip.heading: Impressum-Privatschutz (IP-Management)
privacy.section.recipients.ip.body1: We use the services of Impressum-Privatschutz GmbH, Ludwig-Erhard-Str. 18, 20459 Hamburg, for the management of postal mail sent to us. This provider offers a secure and reliable postal address for our project (for example, for the imprint, privacy policy, withdrawal information and similar legal sections). This use is based on our legitimate interest in protecting our private home addresses while still being reachable as required by law (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.section.recipients.ip.body2: We have concluded a data processing agreement with Impressum-Privatschutz and implement the strict requirements of the German data protection authorities when using this service. Further information about data protection at Impressum-Privatschutz GmbH can be found here:
privacy.section.retention.title: 5. Retention
privacy.section.retention.intro: We keep personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes described above or as required by law:
privacy.section.retention.item1: Server log data is typically kept only for a short period (for example, a few weeks) for security and troubleshooting, and then deleted or anonymised.
privacy.section.retention.item2: Contact requests are kept as long as needed to handle your enquiry and for any follow-up questions, and may be retained for longer where legal retention periods apply.
privacy.section.retention.item3: Account and profile data is stored for as long as you have an account on this site. If you delete your account or ask us to delete it, we will remove or anonymise the associated data, unless legal obligations require longer storage.
privacy.section.retention.item4: Preferences stored locally in your browser (theme/language) remain there until you clear them via your browser settings.
privacy.section.rights.title: 6. Your rights
privacy.section.rights.intro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights with respect to your personal data, subject to the conditions set out in the law:
privacy.section.rights.item.restriction: Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
privacy.section.rights.item.consent: Right to withdraw consent at any time (Art. 7(3) GDPR), without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.
privacy.section.rights.complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, in particular in the EU member state of your habitual residence, your place of work or the place of the alleged infringement.
privacy.section.rights.supervisoryPrefix: For example, in Bavaria the competent authority is the

privacy.section.contact.body: For questions about this privacy policy or to exercise your rights, please contact us via
privacy.footer.disclaimer: This page summarises our current practices for a small private project and is not legal advice.
